what: Grad-CAM attention falling outside the retinal field of view, per image.
method: attention measured on the RAW map before any masking, against a fitted elliptical aperture (models.common.data_quality.retina_mask). The displayed overlay is masked; this measurement is not.

comparison.why_lift_not_raw_pct: the two frames devote different areas to non-retina (structured letterboxes), so raw percentages are not comparable
comparison.prediction_was: the disqualified head should read the frame MORE than the model that replaced it
